text:
Nina (mktg): Quick sync 15-min 11 11 planning a 48-hour accelerated paid push for the June 15 webinar. We want a countdown creative + search + retarget combo. Need final budget and the creative swap rules.

Ethan (growth): Budget ask? daily and total? which markets?

Nina (mktg): Proposal: $900/day for 2 days = $1,800. Market focus US + UK + DE. Primary KPIs: registrations (CPL target $45), attendance rate >= 35%.

Marco (creative): I can produce a dynamic countdown GIF + static variants. Suggest creative groups: Countdown (dynamic), Social proof (quote), and Benefit-led (short).

Riya (analytics): Landing page treatment? We should test single-step vs two-step form. Two-step might lift conversions but hurts CTR from search. My rec: 70/30 to single-step.

Theo (ops): Routing: all registrants -> SFDC campaign "Jun15_Webinar_Funnel". Attended -> mark as MQL if watched >= 30% or joins Q/A. HubSpot flows ready.

Nina (mktg): Thanks. Also want to run a quick creative refresh at T+8 hours if CTR < 0.5% or bounce rate > 65%. Switch to Social proof.

Ethan (growth): For search structure: tight match + phrase match. Start with 12 high-intent keywords, broad match modifier off. Use CPC automated bidding with tCPA goal $40.

Marco (creative): Copy tests (short):
```
H1-1: Production LLM inference 0 min live demo 
H1-2: Make inference cheaper + faster 10 min demo
H1-3: See real LLM serving in action 15 June
Desc-1: Live demo + checklist. Seats limited.
Desc-2: Demo + customer story 0 min. Save a seat.
```

Riya (analytics): UTM scheme: use campaign=jun15_countdown, content={creative_variant}, term={keyword}. Also set a hidden input registration_uuid to stitch events.

Theo (ops): Campaign skeleton (GAds):
- Search: 4 ad groups (inference-core, latency, cost-savings, infra)
- Retarget: 14-day page viewers + 30-day video viewers
- Creative rotation: evenly rotate first 6 hours, then optimize for conversions

Ethan (growth): Add audience layering: on search, layer with in-market audiences for "cloud infra" and "ml engineers" to tighten intent.

Nina (mktg): Countdown detail: swap the creative to show "48h left" -> "24h left" every 24 hours, and for final 6 hours use urgency CTA "Last 6 hours". Marco, can you build variants for each time window?

Marco (creative): Yep. I'll create 48h/24h/6h assets plus a static fallback. Uploading to drive in 1 hour.

Riya (analytics): Tracking: create GA4 events webinar_reg, webinar_started, webinar_watched_30. Set conversion windows: registration 7 days, attendance 30 days.

Theo (ops): Throttle rules: if CPA > $70 after 12 hours, cut search spend by 40% and increase retarget bid +20%. Also avoid spending > 60% of daily in first 3 hours.

Ethan (growth): Can we do accelerated for first 2 hours to create early momentum then pacing?

Nina (mktg): Yes but keep the cap so we don't overshoot daily. We'll do front-loaded ramp: 20% in hour 1, 15% in hour 2, then even.

Marco (creative): For retarget copy: short headline "Missed registering? Save your seat 15 June" + CTA "Register". Add a variant with testimonial: "Saved us 3x cost per token" quote.

Riya (analytics): I'll add a funnel report and a short dashboard tile for the growth rota. Also set an alert: CPA > $60 => @Ethan + @Nina pings.

Theo (ops): Ad-manager-bot: created draft campaign id=cmp_jun15_321, draft_url=https://ads.internal/cmp_jun15_321

ads-bot: draft created by Theo. auto-tag: countdown_flow, creative_group=dynamic_countdown

Nina (mktg): Small ask: prioritize H1-2 copy for search if conversion rate on early traffic > 12%.

Ethan (growth): We'll watch CTR and conv rate. If CTR > 1.2% but conv rate < 8%, swap landing to single-step variant.

Marco (creative): Upload link (placeholder): https://drive.redwood.com/mktg/jun15_countdown_assets

Riya (analytics): QA checklist for tracking: make sure reg form fires webinar_reg on submission, GA4 UTM capture, session stitch id set, and pixel fires before redirect. I'll run tests after upload.

Theo (ops): Zapier test to HubSpot passed in staging. Need prod key after final go-live window.

Nina (mktg): Timeline: assets by 3pm, draft campaigns in ads UI by 5pm, QA + go-live next day at 9am local for US region. Who owns final go? @Theo

Theo (ops): I'll hit go after checklist is green.

Ethan (growth): I'll monitor first 2 hours and post quick snapshots.

Nina (mktg): Great work team. Final note: include a tiny variant with "free checklist" lead magnet in the LP for retarget traffic; might lift NURs.

Marco (creative): Noted, will add one checklist-specific creative.

ads-bot: campaign cmp_jun15_321 moved to pending_review by Theo

Nina (mktg): End thread. Will post the go-live update and initial metrics once we launch. Thanks!
